title: Baldwin amendment: shield Medicaid funding
question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 1693 to H.Con.Res. 14 (2025 budget resolution)
yes_means: Yes was a vote to add a budget reserve fund aimed at preventing Medicaid funding cuts that could close rural hospitals, raise costs for people with other insurance, or increase uncompensated care.

title: House passes H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
question: On Passage of H.R. 1
yes_means: Yes was a vote to pass the House version of the 2025 budget reconciliation bill. Its health provisions included new Medicaid work requirements and limits on how states finance their share of Medicaid.

title: Kim amendment: strike H.R. 1's limits on Medicaid payments
question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 2817 to H.R. 1
yes_means: Yes was a vote to remove the bill's limits on certain Medicaid payments to states and providers.

title: Sanders amendment: halve Medicare drug prices, add dental, vision and hearing
question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 2435 to H.R. 1
yes_means: Yes was a vote to cut prescription drug prices under Medicare in half and expand Medicare to cover dental, vision and hearing.

title: Senate passes H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
question: On Passage of the Bill H.R. 1
yes_means: Yes was a vote to pass the 2025 budget reconciliation bill, which added Medicaid work requirements and limits on state Medicaid financing. It passed 50-50 with the Vice President breaking the tie.

title: House gives final approval to H.R. 1
question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment to H.R. 1
yes_means: Yes was a vote to send the Senate-passed budget reconciliation bill, with its Medicaid work requirements and financing limits, to the President to become law.

title: Extend the expanded ACA premium tax credits
question: On the Cloture Motion to proceed to S. 3385
yes_means: Yes was a vote to move forward a bill extending the enhanced premium tax credits that lower the cost of Affordable Care Act marketplace insurance. It needed 60 votes and got 51.
